newsitem.title: PERU: Third Peru soldier dies after hostage raid - radio.
newsitem.headline: Third Peru soldier dies after hostage raid - radio.

text.p: A third Peruvian commando who took part in the rescue raid at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima has died from his wounds, local radio reported on Saturday.
The CPN radio station identified the dead man as Sgt. Raul Alvarez. Two other commandos died in Tuesday's assault which secured the release of 71 of 72 hostages held by Marxist rebels.

A police source confirmed Alvarez' death, saying the military hospital, where those injured in the raid were taken, had already placed his body in a coffin. The source said the commando would be buried in the next few hours.

But an official at the hospital denied the report. "It's completely false," said the official, who asked to remain anonymous. "The only ones who have died are those whose names have appeared in the press."
The attack on the residence came on the 126th day of the hostage siege.
One hostage and all 14 Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels also died in the assault.
